turns.text: In September 2026, the Average Order Value (AOV) for non-cancelled orders was **€114.39**, based on total revenue of **€12,582.75** across **110** orders.

args.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(amount), COUNT(order_id)), 2) AS average_order_value_eur,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue_eur,
       COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders`
WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01'
  AND order_date <= '2026-09-30'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'

turns.text: The average basket size (average order value across non-cancelled orders) for the week starting Monday, 21 September 2026 (2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27) was **€130.28** (total revenue of €3,387.25 across 26 non-cancelled orders).

args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(CASE
                 WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
             END) AS non_cancelled_orders,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS total_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0
                             END), COUNT(CASE
                                             WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
                                         END)), 2) AS average_basket_size_eur,
       COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders_all_statuses,
       ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount_all_orders
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders`
WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-21' AND '2026-09-27'
